استغبين (form X)
# اِسْتَغْبَيْنَ (istaḡbayna) /is.taɣ.baj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اُسْتُغْبِينَ (ustuḡbīna) /us.tuɣ.biː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اِسْتَغْبِينَ (istaḡbīna) /is.taɣ.biː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
